Attempts a reverse-DNS PTR lookup for th: Attempts a reverse-DNS PTR lookup for the IP address through the system resolver. If it fails, searches public crt.sh records, examines up to the first 15 records and selects the first available domain name. Certificate matches do not establish current DNS resolution.
Calls the c99.nl Subdomain Finder API us: Calls the c99.nl Subdomain Finder API using the input website URL. Creates Website results for discovered subdomains with available IP and Cloudflare information.
Checks the input domain over HTTPS and f: Checks the input domain over HTTPS and falls back to HTTP. For a successful response below HTTP 400, creates a Website record with available page title and response information. Contacts the target website directly.
Crawls pages from the target website usi: Crawls pages from the target website using ReconCrawl and extracts email addresses and phone numbers, adding contact relationships to the graph. The current crawl is limited to 500 pages and uses a one-second request delay.
Crawls the target website with ReconSpre: Crawls the target website with ReconSpread, including links outside its domain, and adds discovered link and domain relationships to the graph. Results depend on reachable pages and crawl limits.
Derives a root domain locally from a sub: Derives a root domain locally from a subdomain and adds a HAS_SUBDOMAIN relationship. Uses a small built-in list of common multi-part country suffixes and otherwise takes the last two labels; it does not use a complete Public Suffix List.
Discovers subdomains using the Subfinder: Discovers subdomains using the Subfinder Docker tool, with public crt.sh certificate-transparency results as a fallback. Removes wildcard prefixes and excludes the root domain from subdomain results.
Expands a CIDR range into individual IP: Expands a CIDR range into individual IP addresses using the ProjectDiscovery MAPCIDR Docker tool. This is address enumeration, not a check that the hosts are reachable.
Extracts the domain portion after @ from: Extracts the domain portion after @ from an email address and creates a Domain record linked to the email. This is local parsing and does not verify DNS or mailbox existence.
Fetches historical WHOIS records for a d: Fetches historical WHOIS records for a domain from Whoxy. Extracts available ownership and contact information and creates related people, organizations, addresses and domain relationships.
Fetches normal Ethereum transactions for: Fetches normal Ethereum transactions for a wallet from Etherscan and creates transaction and wallet relationships. The current implementation requests the first 100 transactions in ascending order, so the result is not a complete transaction history.
Fetches the target page with an HTTP req: Fetches the target page with an HTTP request and extracts its text with BeautifulSoup into a Phrase record. This does not run browser JavaScript, so client-rendered content may be missing.
Fetches the target website with ReconTra: Fetches the target website with ReconTrack and extracts supported tracking identifiers. Creates WebTracker records with the tracker source and code and links them to the website.
Finds open ports using the ProjectDiscov: Finds open ports using the ProjectDiscovery Naabu Docker tool and creates Port records with available service and version information. Passive mode uses provider data; active mode directly probes the target IP.
Generates 20 fabricated domains per inpu: Generates 20 fabricated domains per input IP address, with a one-second delay between results, to exercise streaming and graph updates. This is a synthetic test enricher and performs no real domain discovery.
Generates synthetic test data: a subdoma: Generates synthetic test data: a subdomain prefixed with sub. and a fabricated email address based on the input domain. These are fixtures for testing enrichment and graph updates, not discovered contacts or real DNS findings.
Hashes the normalized email address and: Hashes the normalized email address and checks public Gravatar avatar and profile endpoints. Extracts an available avatar, display name, biography and location; an absent public profile produces no profile finding.
Looks up a phone number using the Veriph: Looks up a phone number using the Veriphone verification API and enriches it with available carrier, country and validity information.
Looks up autonomous systems associated w: Looks up autonomous systems associated with a domain using ProjectDiscovery ASNMAP and adds the results and their relationships to the investigation graph.
Looks up autonomous systems associated with an IP address using ProjectDiscovery ASNMAP and adds the results and their relationships to the investigation graph.
Looks up autonomous systems associated with an organization name using ProjectDiscovery ASNMAP and adds the results and their relationships to the investigation graph.
Looks up CIDR network ranges associated: Looks up CIDR network ranges associated with an autonomous system number using ProjectDiscovery ASNMAP and adds the results and their relationships to the investigation graph.
No API key is configured by this enriche: No API key is configured by this enricher. Individual optional Subfinder data sources may have their own requirements outside this integration.
No API key is configured by this integra: No API key is configured by this integration. The local Maigret executable and its supported target sites must be available.
No API key is configured by this integration. The local Sherlock executable and its supported target sites must be available.
Optional authentication token for the we: Optional authentication token for the webhook
Optional JSON string with additional dat: Optional JSON string with additional data to include in the payload
Optional ProjectDiscovery Cloud Platform: Optional ProjectDiscovery Cloud Platform API key for mapcidr.
Packets per second rate limit (for activ: Packets per second rate limit (for active scans). Default: 1000
Parses the hostname from a website URL,: Parses the hostname from a website URL, removes the port and a leading www. prefix, and creates the corresponding Domain record. This is local URL parsing and does not fetch the website.
Passes the phone-number text to the publ: Passes the phone-number text to the public Hudson Rock Cavalier search-by-username endpoint and creates Device records from any returned infostealer exposure. The current implementation does not use a dedicated phone-number search endpoint, so this is not a verified phone lookup.
PDCP_API_KEY can optionally be passed to: PDCP_API_KEY can optionally be passed to DNSX; ordinary DNS resolution does not require it in this enricher.
PDCP_API_KEY is required for passive mod: PDCP_API_KEY is required for passive mode, which is the default. Active mode does not require this key. The parameter is optional in the schema because the requirement depends on the selected mode.
PDCP_API_KEY may be supplied to the tool: PDCP_API_KEY may be supplied to the tool but is not required by this enricher for CIDR expansion.
Port range to scan (e.g., '80,443,8080': Port range to scan (e.g., '80,443,8080' or '1-1000'). Leave empty for default.
Probes a domain with the ProjectDiscover: Probes a domain with the ProjectDiscovery HTTPX Docker tool using its TLS-probe option. The current enricher emits Website records with available URL, title, content type and HTTP status; it does not emit a structured TLS certificate record.
Probes the target website with the Proje: Probes the target website with the ProjectDiscovery HTTPX Docker tool and its Wappalyzer-based technology detection. Converts detected technology names and available versions into Technology records.
ProjectDiscovery Cloud Platform API key: ProjectDiscovery Cloud Platform API key (required for passive mode)
Queries current domain WHOIS data throug: Queries current domain WHOIS data through the python-whois library and creates a Whois record with available registrar, organization, location, email and registration dates. Availability and redaction depend on the relevant registry; no fixed commercial API provider is configured.
Queries Etherscan NFT transfer history f: Queries Etherscan NFT transfer history for a cryptocurrency wallet and creates NFT records from the returned transfers. The current implementation requests the first page of up to 10,000 transfers; it does not establish current NFT ownership.
Queries Have I Been Pwned for breaches a: Queries Have I Been Pwned for breaches associated with an email address and creates breach records from returned names and metadata. It reports known breach exposure and does not retrieve account passwords.
Queries the public ip-api.com JSON endpo: Queries the public ip-api.com JSON endpoint for an IP address and enriches the input with available latitude, longitude, country, city and ISP. IP geolocation is approximate.
Requests the Scamalytics fraud-risk asse: Requests the Scamalytics fraud-risk assessment for an IP address and creates risk information from the returned score, risk level and proxy-related flags. The assessment reflects the provider’s data, not an independent determination of abuse.
Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY. ETHERSCAN_AP: Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY. ETHERSCAN_API_URL can override the default Etherscan API endpoint.
Requires HIBP_API_KEY. HIBP_API_URL can: Requires HIBP_API_KEY. HIBP_API_URL can override the breached-account endpoint.
Requires PDCP_API_KEY for the ASNMAP int: Requires PDCP_API_KEY for the ASNMAP integration.
Requires SCAMLYTICS_API_KEY and SCAMLYTI: Requires SCAMLYTICS_API_KEY and SCAMLYTICS_USERNAME (these are the current configuration spellings). SCAMLYTICS_API_HOST optionally selects the account’s API node.
Resolves a domain through the system DNS: Resolves a domain through the system DNS resolver using socket.gethostbyname. Returns one IPv4 address for each successfully resolved domain; it does not enumerate all DNS records or IPv6 addresses.
Resolves a domain to IPv4 addresses and,: Resolves a domain to IPv4 addresses and, when enabled, IPv6 addresses using the ProjectDiscovery DNSX Docker tool. Adds the resolved IP addresses and domain relationships to the graph.
Retrieves historical WHOIS records for a: Retrieves historical WHOIS records for a domain using the WhoisXML API WHOIS History service. Converts available historical registration and contact information into graph records.
Runs a Whoxy reverse-WHOIS search for th: Runs a Whoxy reverse-WHOIS search for the input email address, matching the registrant/contact email. Adds returned domains and available contact relationships. A matching record is an association from WHOIS data, not proof of current ownership.

Runs a Whoxy reverse-WHOIS search for the input organization name, matching the company name. Adds returned domains and available contact relationships. A matching record is an association from WHOIS data, not proof of current ownership.

Runs a Whoxy reverse-WHOIS search for the input person’s full name, matching the registrant/contact name. Adds returned domains and available contact relationships. A matching record is an association from WHOIS data, not proof of current ownership.
Runs the local Maigret command-line tool: Runs the local Maigret command-line tool to search public websites for the input username and converts its JSON report into social-account records and available profile details. A username match does not prove that accounts belong to the same person.
Runs the local Sherlock command-line too: Runs the local Sherlock command-line tool to search public websites for the input username and converts reported profile URLs into SocialAccount records. A username match does not prove that accounts belong to the same person.
Scan mode: active (direct port scanning): Scan mode: active (direct port scanning) or passive (using PDCP database)
Scan top N ports (e.g., '100', '1000'). Overrides port_range if set.
Searches DeHashed breach data for the in: Searches DeHashed breach data for the input domain. Converts matching identity fields, such as names, email addresses and usernames, into Individual records and links them to the input. Matches are reported associations, not independently verified identities.

Searches DeHashed breach data for the input email address. Converts matching identity fields, such as names, email addresses and usernames, into Individual records and links them to the input. Matches are reported associations, not independently verified identities.

Searches DeHashed breach data for the input IP address. Converts matching identity fields, such as names, email addresses and usernames, into Individual records and links them to the input. Matches are reported associations, not independently verified identities.

Searches DeHashed breach data for the input username. Converts matching identity fields, such as names, email addresses and usernames, into Individual records and links them to the input. Matches are reported associations, not independently verified identities.
Searches the French public company-searc: Searches the French public company-search API by a person’s full name, with a limit of 25 results, and creates matching organizations and WORKS_FOR relationships. A name match alone does not independently verify employment or distinguish namesakes.

Searches the French public company-search API by organization name and enriches company information such as SIREN/SIRET identifiers, address, activity and available leaders. Coverage is French businesses and name matches may be ambiguous.
Searches the public Hudson Rock Cavalier: Searches the public Hudson Rock Cavalier endpoint by email address for infostealer exposure. Creates Device records from available computer name, operating system, stealer family, IP and compromise-date information.

Searches the public Hudson Rock Cavalier endpoint by username for infostealer exposure and creates Device records with available computer, operating-system, IP, stealer and compromise-date information. Username matches may refer to different people.
Sends the input entities and configured: Sends the input entities and configured payload to a user-specified n8n webhook so that an external workflow can process them. The actual enrichment and returned entity types depend on that workflow; no fixed data source is implied.
System reverse DNS and the public crt.sh: System reverse DNS and the public crt.sh fallback require no configured API key.
Takes the local part of an email address: Takes the local part of an email address before @ and creates a Username candidate. This is a local inference and does not verify that an account with that username exists.
The Etherscan API key to use for the NFT: The Etherscan API key to use for the NFT lookup.
The Etherscan API key to use for the tra: The Etherscan API key to use for the transaction lookup.
The Etherscan API URL to use for the NFT: The Etherscan API URL to use for the NFT lookup.
The Etherscan API URL to use for the tra: The Etherscan API URL to use for the transaction lookup.
The HIBP API key to use for breaches loo: The HIBP API key to use for breaches lookup.
The HIBP API URL to use for breaches loo: The HIBP API URL to use for breaches lookup.
The n8n webhook URL to send data to: The n8n webhook URL to send data to
The ProjectDiscovery Cloud Platform API: The ProjectDiscovery Cloud Platform API key for asnmap.
The Scamalytics API key for IP-based loo: The Scamalytics API key for IP-based lookups.
The veriphone API key for phone number c: The veriphone API key for phone number carrier lookups.
The webhook URL is required. An optional: The webhook URL is required. An optional auth_token is sent as a Bearer token when configured; authentication requirements depend on the destination webhook.
The WhoisXML API key for WHOIS history l: The WhoisXML API key for WHOIS history lookups.
The Whoxy API key to use for domain hist: The Whoxy API key to use for domain history lookups.
The Whoxy API key to use for domain look: The Whoxy API key to use for domain lookups.
Uses a local crawling integration and co: Uses a local crawling integration and contacts target pages directly; no provider API key is configured.
Uses a local extraction library and cont: Uses a local extraction library and contacts the target website directly; no provider API key is configured.
Uses public Gravatar endpoints without a: Uses public Gravatar endpoints without a configured API key.
Uses the public endpoint without a confi: Uses the public endpoint without a configured API key.
Uses the public French Recherche d’entre: Uses the public French Recherche d’entreprises API; no API key is configured.
Uses the public Hudson Rock Cavalier OSI: Uses the public Hudson Rock Cavalier OSINT endpoint; no API key is configured by this enricher.
